# impl

## Overview
Generated GrammarKit PSI element implementations for Dart AST nodes.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.impl.Dart*Impl (e.g., DartClassDefinitionImpl, DartMethodDeclarationImpl, DartExpressionImpl, DartForStatementImpl)

## Invariants
- All PSI nodes extend ASTWrapperPsiElement or AbstractDartPsiClass/AbstractDartComponentImpl.
- Auto-generated by GrammarKit; not intended for manual editing.

## Side Effects
- Performs PSI tree navigation and AST node lookup within IntelliJ PSI read actions.
